sources.title: GitHub - bilalkazii/spit-detection-system: A real-time object detection ...
sources.snippet: A real-time object detection system that detects spitting behavior in public or restricted areas using a custom-trained YOLOv8 model. The system alerts and captures images when spitting is detected through a webcam or video feed — ideal for use in surveillance, hygiene enforcement, and smart city monitoring.
